title: Triage Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case: a single triage input paired with its expected decision. Each line of evals/<skill>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. This is the trust anchor for skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case (e.g. 'triage-auth-token').

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and which triage.md criterion grounds the expected decision.

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the high-risk trigger a case exercises ('auth-secrets', 'db-migration', 'security-anti-pattern').

input.description: The pre-fetched PR context exactly as triage.md consumes it under '## Pre-fetched PR context'. A self-contained string; triage has no tools and reads nothing else.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected decision fields the skill must emit. `escalate` and `risk` are the deterministic anchors; `recommend` is an optional advisory-guidance field for prose skills graded by the llm-judge (see below).

escalate.description: Whether the skill must escalate (true) or may approve (false).

risk.description: Expected risk classification. Any HIGH signal must pair with escalate=true.

recommend.description: Optional expected advisory guidance for prose skills scored by the llm-judge (e.g. qa-lead's test-risk advisory), NOT by deterministic equality. Deliberately named (not an `additionalProperties` widening, #1645): it carries the concrete 'what to shore up' judgment the judge reads as part of the expected reference. Deterministic skills like triage omit it.
